research_question: RQ1 participant-independent binary N3 detection across heterogeneous datasets
required_data: single-channel EEG, scored hypnograms, participant & cohort IDs, external cohort
available_data: ISRUC-I (100, C4), Sleep-EDF SC (78, Fpz-Cz), ISRUC-III (10); 2 scorers for ISRUC
existing_code: v1: grouped CV, fixed 0.5 threshold, test-fold checkpoint selection, wrong channel for 83/100 ISRUC
missing_code: v1 needed: channel fix, inner validation, threshold selection, participant CIs, LOCO -> implemented in v2
validation_method: 5-fold participant CV + LOCO + external ISRUC-III + inter-rater benchmark, participant bootstrap CI
safe_claim: single-channel binary N3 detection evaluated participant-independently across two montages and an external cohort
unsafe_claim: any v1 number (channel bug); 'outperforms SOTA' without identical protocol

research_question: RQ2 separate factor scores for detected N3
required_data: continuous EEG with epoch order; slow-wave detector; independent reference
available_data: EEG + order (v2 keeps epoch index); second scorer; Sleep-EDF age/sex sheet
existing_code: v1: delta power, RMS, peak counter, broadband ZCR
missing_code: v1 needed: zero-crossing SW detector, spectral ratios/entropy, true continuity, montage-referenced scaling -> implemented in v2
circularity_risk: moderate if validated against its own inputs; avoided by independent references
validation_method: homeostatic early>late decline, expert N3>N2, scorer-disagreement continuum, age association
safe_claim: rule-derived factor scores show physiologically expected behaviour against independent references
